hornNodes.screwActorRecenterMeaning: Subtract [0,0,0.00205] metres from retaining-screw mesh in native coordinates; bind outer head face to screw actor position. Actor local +Z is outward after adapter. Retaining head only; no shaft or pointed supplied screw is invented.
hornNodes.noDuplicateRule: Existing Horn actor owns its disc side and existing HornScrew actor owns retaining-screw. Exclude those nodes from fixed body group; never combine complete hd1910-servo.glb with separate discs.
hornNodes.sourceMatchedRearFor482: Mechanical actors motor/l_motor/h_mouthMotor had opposite small hub only. Keep rear eight-hole-disc and retaining-screw absent unless source/package decision explicitly adds them. Optional shaft-hub alone is geometrical surrogate, radius differs and fit unverified. Preparation p_motor may show both approved discs.

sockets.reason: servo-body.glb already includes socket shells and contacts. Existing prototype-v3.mjs synthesized servoSocket geometry would duplicate them.
sockets.formula: dock_actor_local = t_body + R_body * socketNativePositionMm + R_body*[0,0,1]*2.25. World = actorPosePosition + actorQuaternion*dock_actor_local.

cable.adapterFormula: socketQuaternion(port) * Rx(-pi/2); native +Y -> -port.normal, native +X -> port.tangent, native +Z -> port.normal cross port.tangent
cable.individualNativeWireExitAnchors: add native X offsets [-1.3,0,1.3] mm to the listed centre-line exit anchor; original source wire endpoints at z +/-65 mm. Native wire actual tube extrema extend to +/-65.37039 due bend cross-section.
cable.routing: Keep extracted plug meshes at physical size. Rebuild 3 black tubes along teaching path, anchored at transformed plug wireExit anchors. Do not uniformly scale/deform both white plugs to fit fixed 134 mm original centre separation. The socket neighbor should follow transformed side exit tangent instead of assuming normal-axis wire exit.
cable.materials: Clone PBR material objects with maps retained. servo-body photographed-label material real-HD1910M-label contains embedded texture; never replace it by actor color.

limitations: Axis line and 34x20x23 housing align to existing source geometry; this is not collision, bore, tolerance, physical fit, cable length or electrical validation.
Two-sided old source geometry does not identify front vs back. Explicit front sign conventions are recorded per actor; their source shaft line remains exact regardless of sign.
New socket locations and plug construction are approved appearance estimates. Geometric nearest port-slot assignment does not identify real daisy-chain ports or pins.

New 29 mm full disc envelope is 1 mm shorter than older 30 mm double-disc source; do not stretch it to 30 or shrink to 23. Old removal seated actors were deliberately offset outside old geometry; reset initial seat to new 12.45 mm native seating and preserve tray endpoints/action order.
Original retaining-screw node is an estimated visible head, not a verified full screw. The unknown supplied short pointed screw remains excluded.
